from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem

mol = Chem.RWMol()
idx = {}
def add(sym, name):
    a = Chem.Atom(sym)
    i = mol.AddAtom(a)
    idx[name] = i
    return i

add('N','N1'); add('C','CB'); add('C','CC'); add('C','CD'); add('C','CE'); add('C','CF')
add('C','CG'); add('C','CH2b'); add('N','N2'); add('C','CJ'); add('C','CK'); add('C','C12')
add('C','C13'); add('C','CHO'); add('O','OCHO'); add('O','O12'); add('O','O13')
for i in range(1,11): add('C','P%d'%i)
for i in range(1,11): add('C','Q%d'%i)

B = Chem.BondType
bonds = [
 ('N1','CB',B.DOUBLE),
 ('N1','P1',B.SINGLE),
 ('CB','CC',B.SINGLE),
 ('CC','CD',B.SINGLE),
 ('CD','CE',B.SINGLE),
 ('CE','CF',B.SINGLE),
 ('CF','CG',B.SINGLE),
 ('CG','CHO',B.SINGLE),
 ('CHO','OCHO',B.DOUBLE),
 ('CG','CH2b',B.SINGLE),
 ('CH2b','N2',B.SINGLE),
 ('N2','CK',B.SINGLE),
 ('CK','CJ',B.SINGLE),
 ('CJ','CG',B.SINGLE),
 ('CJ','N1',B.SINGLE),
 ('CK','CD',B.SINGLE),
 ('CK','C12',B.SINGLE),
 ('C12','C13',B.SINGLE),
 ('C12','O12',B.SINGLE),
 ('C13','O13',B.SINGLE),
 ('C13','Q10',B.SINGLE),
]
for i in range(1,10): bonds.append(('P%d'%i,'P%d'%(i+1),B.SINGLE))
bonds.append(('P10','CG',B.SINGLE))
qb = [('N2','Q1',B.SINGLE),('Q1','Q2',B.SINGLE),('Q2','Q3',B.SINGLE),('Q3','Q4',B.SINGLE),
      ('Q4','Q5',B.DOUBLE),('Q5','Q6',B.SINGLE),('Q6','Q7',B.SINGLE),('Q7','Q8',B.DOUBLE),
      ('Q8','Q9',B.SINGLE),('Q9','Q10',B.DOUBLE)]
bonds += qb

for a,b,o in bonds:
    mol.AddBond(idx[a], idx[b], o)

m = mol.GetMol()
Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
m = Chem.AddHs(m)
from rdkit import Chem as C
print('formula:', C.rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(m))
params = AllChem.ETKDGv3()
params.randomSeed = 42
params.maxIterations = 2000
conf_ok = AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m, params)
print('embed:', conf_ok)
if conf_ok == 0:
    AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m, maxIters=5000)
    Chem.MolToMolFile(m, 'answer.mol')
    # write xyz
    conf = m.GetConformer()
    lines = [str(m.GetNumAtoms()), 'mol_0296 built structure']
    for a in m.GetAtoms():
        p = conf.GetAtomPosition(a.GetIdx())
        lines.append('%-2s %12.6f %12.6f %12.6f' % (a.GetSymbol(), p.x, p.y, p.z))
    open('answer.xyz','w').write('\n'.join(lines)+'\n')
    print('written')
else:
    print('embed failed')
EOF
